message:
forgectl oidc set-client: the help names the router's callback path (#24)

The help said /auth/callback; the router serves GET /callback. The path
is now the constant web.CallbackPath, used by the route, and a test
fails if the help stops naming it.

Co-authored-by: Claude Sonnet 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
